title: Jurisdiction frame (per-vocabulary, opt-in receipt scoping) — CANDIDATE, non-binding
description: A LOCAL declaration scoping receipt species to the obligations they may fund, per vocabulary. No default fungibility: a species not scoped to an obligation cannot fund it (nothing in custody scoped to the demanded obligation => underivable, at any depth). SCREENING, NOT ENFORCEMENT: the frame is checked against presented material; frame quality (over-/under-declaration) is the declarant's visible burden. Only the TOTAL god-receipt form is screened (a species scoped to every obligation) — no graded 'too much coverage' policy, deliberately.

declarant.description: Who declares (and visibly carries the quality burden of) this frame.

vocabulary.description: The vocabulary this frame is local to. Frames are per-vocabulary; there is no cross-vocabulary master frame.

receipt_species.description: The receipt species being scoped (e.g. 'profile_bridge_receipt', 'stage_ascent_receipt', a domain species). Species cross-use (bridge-as-rung, rung-as-bridge) satisfies custody shape and FAILS this screen.

funds_obligations.description: The obligations this species may fund, enumerated. Coverage of k distinct obligations costs k distinct held receipts in single-scoped frames — no bulk discount; broad custody is legitimate when paid.
